title: Major Richard Star Act
cboCostEstimateTitle: H.R. 2102, Major Richard Star Act - As introduced in the House of Representatives on March 14, 2025
summary: Major Richard Star Act This bill allows a veteran with a combat-related disability to receive retirement pay, without reduction, concurrently with their disability compensation. This includes veterans with a combat-related disability and fewer than 20 years of creditable service. (Currently, veterans who receive combat-related special compensation and retirement pay are subject to an offset in retirement pay for concurrent receipt of such benefits.)
latestAction: Referred to the Subcommittee on Disability Assistance and Memorial Affairs.
